title: Hamlet (demo cut)
author: William Shakespeare
subtitle: Demo of the format. Public domain source.

segments.text: [stand center. dont move. stare past the judges like ur arguing with urself]
To be, or not to be, that is the question:
segments.tag: [quiet, like ur asking urself for real. pause after 'be' both times]

segments.text: Whether 'tis nobler in the mind to suffer The slings and arrows of outrageous fortune,
Or to take arms against a sea of troubles And by opposing end them.
segments.tag: [get louder. make a fist on 'take arms'. let it drop on 'end them']

segments.text: Everyone hits a point where giving up and pushing through feel the same size. Hamlet, by William Shakespeare.
segments.tag: [ur real voice. calm. look at each judge once]

segments.text: [take one step forward. hands open like ur weighing two things]
To die: to sleep; No more;
segments.tag: [almost a whisper. wait 2 secs after 'no more']

segments.text: To sleep: perchance to dream: ay, there's the rub;
segments.tag: [lil laugh at urself on 'perchance'. then stop smiling on 'rub']

segments.text: For who would bear the whips and scorns of time,
segments.tag: [angry now. faster. count the list on ur fingers]

segments.text: The pangs of despised love, the law's delay,
segments.tag: [voice cracks on 'love'. dont stop for it]

segments.text: But that the dread of something after death, The undiscover'd country from whose bourn No traveller returns, puzzles the will
segments.tag: [slow way down. look up and far away on 'undiscover'd country']

segments.text: Thus conscience does make cowards of us all;
And lose the name of action.
segments.tag: [quiet. last word soft. hold 3 secs. bow]
